citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 1:04 PM on
10JUL2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by calling and texting. The licensee returned the inspectors'
call and said he was out of town and no one would be available at the time to aid in the inspection. Failure to provide
access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to
provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section

Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries. 
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 1:04 PM on 
10JUL2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by calling and texting. The licensee returned the inspectors' 
call and said he was out of town and no one would be available at the time to aid in the inspection. Failure to provide 
access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to 
provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action. 
 
 
End Section
